hq_error_characterisation.evidence_that_it_was_a_genuine_miss_not_: The producer blob is 6560d7a9 ONLY at candidate 1982dec1, the sole binding prior to the three rebinds. Every one of the three rebinds carries 2385cd32. A reader who opened the earliest court binding and read the producer from it would obtain exactly the value HQ reported, with no further error.
hq_error_characterisation.qualification: C1 and HQ182's C2 are not the same error. C1 was reading the wrong BINDING, not a truncated VALUE; the value read was complete and correctly parsed, just bound to the wrong candidate. HQ182's C2 was completing a truncated grep by guessing, which is a value-integrity failure. Both are failures to establish provenance before concluding, so grouping them is fair, but they are distinct mechanisms and C1 is the milder of the two.
hq_error_characterisation.note_on_my_own_check: The failure mode recurred once more inside the corrected packet itself, in a milder form: the substitute justification generalised from 4 verified files to the whole court without checking the closure. That is a provenance-before-concluding failure of the same family.
